properties.description: Boroughs (arrondissements) and linked cities of the Montreal agglomeration, simplified to about 25 m. Feature properties: name (exactly as written in the source, NOM), kind, stationBoroughName (the borough string used by the bixi-flows dataset; equal to name where no BIXI station has that borough), areaKm2. Polygon part p owns rings polygonRingOffsets[p]..[p+1]; partFeature maps part to feature.
properties.source: Ville de Montreal, Limites administratives de l'agglomeration de Montreal (arrondissements et villes liees), WGS 84 GeoJSON, dataset modified 2023-11-29 (DATEMODIF), downloaded 2026-10-07
properties.attribution: Ville de Montréal, données ouvertes (CC BY 4.0)
notes: Stations in Laval, Longueuil, Boucherville, Sainte-Julie and Terrebonne lie outside the agglomeration: they have no polygon here.
